name: sorrycode-image2
description: Generate and edit images by reusing the active Codex SorryCode key.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images with your current SorryCode key
interface.longDescription: SorryCode Image2 reuses the active Codex SorryCode provider key for Images API generation and editing. It asks for an Image2-group SORRYCODE_API_KEY only when the current key is unavailable or lacks image capability, and never stores credentials in diagnostics.
defaultPrompt: Use SorryCode Image2 to generate an image with my current Codex provider
Use SorryCode Image2 to edit this local image
